responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines H8/300 prologue-, epilogue-, save/restore-, and return-related RTL patterns, including push/pop expanders for different pointer modes, ldm/stm multi-register save/restore, ordinary and interrupt/monitor returns, monitor prologue sequences, and the prologue/epilogue expanders that call into target C++ hooks. It owns the instruction-level side of stack-frame setup and teardown and the specialized return sequences for H8SX and monitor/interrupt functions, distinct from the generic move and branch files.
